description: A Jupyter Notebook script for a semi-custom AI chatbot project integrating OpenAI GPT-3.5 and Google GEMINI models to generate SQL queries from natural language questions and subsequently formulate detailed answers based on database content. It includes code for setting environment variables, database connection, model initialization, prompt generation, query extraction, database querying, and answer synthesis.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt combining user question and instructions for SQL query generation.

methods.name: openai_model
methods.description: Sends a prompt to OpenAI's chat completion API to generate SQL queries.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql and ``` from the model's response.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the generated SQL query on the database and retrieves data.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts textual content from GEMINI model response object.

methods.name: cost_counter
methods.description: Calculates token-based cost for query and answer processing.
